summary: Solar Wanderer is a Three.js/WebGL 3D solar system explorer that runs entirely in the browser. Every view starts at /en/ and clicks "Enter the solar system". Saved 5 views: (1) explorer-earth: the default 3D explore view orbiting Earth. It shows the sim time panel, the celestial directory with search and categories, the target info card, the navigation HUD and the compass. (2) help-overlay: the controls overlay opened with H. (3) guided-tour: the "Journey of the Giants" tour at Jupiter, with the tour control bar and the tour list expanded. (4) free-flight: 6DOF flight mode (F), showing the spacecraft and the flight HUD with speed and gear. (5) asteroid-belt-overview: a top-down panorama of the inner system with orbits and asteroids, reached through "Belts & panoramas". Skipped: the start splash, the directory search dropdown (the harness rejected it as too close to view 1), and the Saturn and Moon fly-to views (same layout, different body). Surface walking needs a manual landing (scrolling all the way in), and the "Standing on the Moon" tour never landed in my tests, so I could not capture that mode reliably.
